# VRAM DB - ComfyUI Custom Node & VRAM Footprint Directory

> VRAM DB is the authoritative technical index for ComfyUI custom node memory requirements, Python dependencies, CUDA bindings, and installation troubleshooting guides.

## Core Resources
- [Workflow Analyzer Tool](https://vramdb.com/tools/workflow-analyzer): Browser tool to analyze missing node red-boxes and aggregate VRAM requirements.
- [GPU Price & VRAM Leaderboard](https://vramdb.com/gpus/best-vram-per-dollar): Mem-value scorecard for local AI hardware choices.
